name: appId
label: App ID
help: In the Hibira portal: your app > Overview > Credentials.

name: secret
label: Secret
help: Shown once, when you create the app (or rotate the secret). Used to sign requests here; it is never sent.

name: baseUrl
label: API URL
help: https://ws.hibira.io for the default cluster. Change it only for another cluster or a self-hosted server.
